text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of a public member from the Aboriginal community to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors.

City Council on July 28 and 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Jay Pariseau as a public member from the Aboriginal community to the Heritage Toronto Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 2, 2024 and until a successor is appointed.
